scope: AKMM Chapter 4 (pp. 93-127) and Appendix 4.A (pp. 827-835): finite- and infinite-horizon sequence problems (existence, Result 1, the finite-horizon NGM and Example 4.1, CRRA utility and the EIS, boundedness, Ponzi schemes and the lifetime budget, Proposition 4.4), balanced growth, the Bellman equation and recursive formulations, the properties of the value function (with a counterexample to property 5), guess-and-verify and the functional Euler equation, global dynamics and the policy slope of the NGM, Theorems .3 and .4, and the phase diagram (the loci of Figures .1-.3, the saddle path and convergence iff on it, and the paths above and below it).
source: Marina Azzimonti, Per Krusell, Alisdair McKay and Toshihiko Mukoyama, Macroeconomics (draft of December 2025), Chapter 4
